question: Should the Claws plan JSON contract grow artifact/provenance preview metadata in this core stack before the RFC and prerequisite PRs land?
rationale: Automation can repair the duplicated parser, but it cannot decide whether this new Claw plan surface is the permanent core contract or should wait for RFC/stack approval.

options.title: Proceed after parser repair
options.body: Keep this read-only core slice, require canonical npm parser reuse, and continue maintainer/RFC review before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the RFC
options.body: Hold this PR until the RFC and prerequisite stack are accepted, then re-review the plan JSON contract as one coordinated surface.

options.title: Move out of core
options.body: Reject this core surface for now and route Claw artifact provenance preview to a ClawHub or plugin-owned prototype.

recommendation.title: Proceed after parser repair
recommendation.body: Keep this read-only core slice, require canonical npm parser reuse, and continue maintainer/RFC review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the visible Claws RFC/stack context and can adjust this slice to match the intended rollout before maintainers decide.
